theme.primary_deployment: MSP Multi-tenant & DevOps / Cloud-Native Linux & Windows Fleets

key_functionalities: Dashboard metrics with live patch deployment stats
Systems inventory management with multi-tenant filtering
Patches catalog & approval workflow with CVE vulnerability mapping
Patch Job creation & execution lifecycle (Running, Scheduled, Completed, Failed)
Maintenance windows scheduling & blackout periods calendar
Compliance scoring & SLA reports with non-compliant system drilldowns
Vulnerability scanner feeds and repository sync jobs
Administration, Role-based access control, and Agent management
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use clean slate grays (#0B0F17, #131C2E) with crisp blue accents (#2563EB).
Implement full collapsible sidebar matching the requested hierarchy.
Support full state management for creating patch jobs, approving patches, syncing repositories, and viewing compliance metrics.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or sticky headers.
Use Lucide icons and Shadcn UI primitives for modals, tabs, dropdowns, and tables.
